newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel premiums stable, focus shifts to Dec.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel premiums stable, focus shifts to Dec.

text.p: NWE jet fuel premiums were unchanged in desultory physical business on Wednesday and traders said the focus of interest was shifting to the December delivery period.

Prices gained in line with benchmark IPE futures, which rose $3.25 to $225.00 on colder Europe temperatures and a drop in U.S. crude stocks. Premiums for barges were notionally Dec IPE +$28/29 fob Rotterdam, unchanged. Cargoes were Dec IPE +$30.
In the Med, EU-qualified was notionally around cif high quotes +$6, with Libyan at cif high +$2.5 for small parcels and $+5 for larger ones.
